spec.name: Furniture Table Lamp
spec.description: A compact orange-shaded terracotta lamp on an integrated narrow oak pedestal stand. Stepped pottery and a broad shade give it a warm, practical survival-furniture silhouette. Connected, axis-aligned construction fits entirely within one block.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: small terracotta table lamp with orange shade on integrated narrow wood stand. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..16, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
